title: [Short-term memory processes during delayed visual differentiation after bilateral removal of the 7th field of the parietal cortex in Rhesus macaca].
abstract: Extirpation of the parietal cortex area 7 aggravated delayed visual discrimination of all visual attributes including shape, colour and spatial relationship in adult rhesus monkeys. Oxymetacil improved the shape and colour discrimination alone.
journal: Rossiiskii fiziologicheskii zhurnal imeni I.M. Sechenova
